description: Creates a package from selected resources in a Cognigy.AI project. Packages bundle flows, endpoints, and other resources for transfer between projects. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to create. Async operation.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without creating. Set to false to actually create.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to check task status (1-10 seconds, default 3)

projectId.description: The project ID to create the package in

resourceIds.description: Array of resource IDs to include in the package (flows, endpoints, etc.)

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for package creation (5-600 seconds, default 120)

name: create_package
